known_gaps: This is a prototype and not a full D&D 2024 combat rules implementation.
Turn-timing and concentrations need exact initiative-boundary tracking.
Proposed smoke characteristics require explicit approval to become canonical.
Potion of Speed, growth, flare/trap remain manual/blocked to avoid incorrect resource spends.
Other consumables with only partially simulated benefits require audit.
Other abilities from the character registry still need handlers and regression tests.
Weapon swapping currently treats listed owned weapons as immediately selectable; carrying / stowing hands still needs detailed implementation.
A full integration with the previous v10 action list remains incomplete.
